title: Trackside Letter Train
hook: Observe the railway without entering its path.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D railway storybook, toy trains, clean platforms and trackside scenes; visual identity: Trackside Letter Train

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child observing railways from a safe boundary
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: rail object -> observable function -> no-track boundary
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Trackside Letter Train a trackside evidence lesson: track geometry, cars, motive power, yard work, signals, crossings and waiting spaces are observed from safe public locations, never from the track itself.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child sketches railway evidence from behind a boundary; Yard Engine and Hopper Car reveal freight work while platform and waiting room reveal passenger use.
